translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi.

content.text: Yaye Nyasaye ma apako,
kik ilingʼ,
nimar joma timbegi richo gi jo-miriambo osemonja gi wechegi;
gisewuoyo kuomwa marach,
adier gisewacho miriambo kuoma.
Gilwora koni gi koni gi weche mag achaya;
gibuka maonge gima omiyo.
An aherogi to gin to gimon koda.
Gitimona kamano kata obedo ni an to alemonegi.
Gichula rach kar ber,
kod achaya kar osiep.
Ket ngʼat marach mondo oked kod jasika;
we jadonj ne ji mondo ochungʼ kode e bura.
Kiyale to mi mondo oyude gi ketho,
kendo kata lemo molamo onego onyis kethone.
Mad ngʼad ndalone dok manok;
kendo mad ngʼat machielo kaw tije.
Mad nyithinde dongʼ kiye
kendo chiege dongʼ dhako ma chwore otho.
Mad nyithinde lokre jokwecho mabayo abaya;
mad riembgi gia koda ka e miechgi mosekethore.
Mad jagope moro mak gige duto ma en-go
kendo mad joma welo oyak mwandu duto moseloso.
Onego ngʼato kik timne ngʼwono
kata kecho nyithinde modongʼ kiye.
Kothe duto mondo kargi olal nono,
kendo nying-gi oruchi kik bedi e tiengʼ mabiro.
Mad Jehova Nyasaye sik kaparo richo mane wuonegi otimo;
kendo mad richo min kik ruchi.
Richogi mondo osiki e nyim Jehova Nyasaye,
eka mondo ongʼad kargi oko chuth e piny.
Nimar kane ongima to ne ok odewo timo ngʼwono,
kar timo kamano to nosando jodhier,
kaachiel gi joma ochando gi joma chunygi lit;
nosandogi malit nyaka ne githo.
Nohero kwongʼo ji
to koro mad kwongʼneno dogne;
ne ok ohero gwedho ji
omiyo koro mad gweth bed mabor kode.
Ne orwako kwongʼ ka nangane;
mad kwongʼno koro donji e dende ka pi,
mad gibud chokene ka mo.
Mad ochal nanga moumogo dende duto,
kata kamba motweyego nyaka chiengʼ.
Mano ema mondo obed chudo, ma Jehova Nyasaye chulo joma donjona;
mano e kaka onego otim ne joma wuoyo marach kuoma.
To in, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto,
timna maber nikech nyingi;
konya nikech ber mar herani.
Nimar adhier kendo achando,
kendo chunya winjo marach e iya.
Ndalona rumo mos mos ka tipo mar odhiambo
kendo yamo uka ka det bonyo.
Chongena onyosore nikech onge gima acham,
kendo adhero alokora choke lilo.
Alokora gima ijaro ne joma donjona;
ka ginena to gitwenyona umgi ka gigoyona siboi.
Konya, yaye Jehova Nyasaye Nyasacha,
resa kaluwore gi herani.
Mi mondo gingʼe ni achal kama nikech lweti,
mi gingʼe ni lweti ema osetime, yaye Jehova Nyasaye.
Gin ginyalo kwongʼa to angʼeyo ni in ibiro gwedha;
ka gimonja to ibiro kuodo wigi,
to jatichni to biro bedo mamor.
Wichkuot maduongʼ biro mako joma donjona
kendo gibiro rwako wichkuot ka kandho.
Abiro dhialo Jehova Nyasaye malich gi dhoga;
abiro pake e dier oganda maduongʼ.
Nimar ochungʼ e bat korachwich mar ngʼat mochando,
mondo ores ngimane kuom joma ngʼadone buch tho.
